Sabarimala Prasadam Unit to Fix FSSAI Deficiencies, Tells Kerala HC

The Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) informed the Kerala High Court that it will rectify deficiencies flagged by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) at the Sabarimala Prasadam making unit. The TDB's statement addresses concerns raised by the FSSAI regarding food safety standards.
